Why Supabase fits

  • Structured PostgreSQL data for leads, plans, and content
  • Secure admin login through Supabase Auth
  • Row-level security to protect customer data
  • Works with a static frontend and Edge Functions
  • Simple path from prototype to production
Suggested tables
profilesAdmin users and roles
leadsContact enquiries and pipeline status
plansPrices, features, and visibility
site_contentEditable website copy stored as JSON
audit_logTrack sensitive admin changes
Important security rule

Never place a Supabase service-role key in browser code. Use the public anonymous key with strict row-level security, and perform privileged actions through an authenticated Edge Function.
